name: Apaches
description: The Apaches were a Puerto Rican gang based at the corner of Pacific and Nevins Streets in Brooklyn's Boerum Hill neighborhood, near the Gowanus Projects. They had interactions with other local gangs including the Mau Maus and South Brooklyn Boys in the late 1950s.

sources.title: Papo of the Apaches Gang | New York City Fighting Gangs
